**Status:** production invention; extent derived from the widest delivered composition.

PLAZA is open, level ground. It must extend far enough that CHORUS remains visibly contained at the widest delivered composition, but the numeric extent belongs to model design once formation reach and composition are known. No wall, step, obstacle, or competing landmark is part of this starter.

**Status:** production invention; shared spatial anchor.

The named point `plaza-center` is the ground-level world origin. SOLOIST begins there, while every other placement states its relation to the same anchor rather than creating a second origin.

**Status:** production invention; applies to every delivered subject observation.

PLAZA provides a neutral uninterrupted background behind SOLOIST's raised hand and behind the edges of CHORUS. Any added feature that competes with those silhouettes changes the setting and must be authored here before a model or shot uses it.
